definitions.explanation: A price that is high relative to normal or expected levels. Commonly used in financial markets, shopping, and economic discussions. The opposite is {安値|やすね}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高値|たかね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最|さい}{高値|たかね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: It set a new high for the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}→輸入品：11505_yunyuuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高値|たかね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the weak yen, imported goods are trading at high prices, increasing the burden on consumers.

notes:
A compound of {高|たか} (high) + ⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price/value). Standard financial and commercial vocabulary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高値|たかね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (reach a high price)
- {高値|たかね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧ (set a new high)
- {最|さい}{高値|たかね} (highest price, all-time high)
- {高値|たかね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ (sell at a high price)
- {高値|たかね}{圏|けん} (high-price range)

SIMILAR WORDS:
The opposite is ⟦{安値|やすね}→安値：12278_yasune⟧ (low price). For general "expensive" in everyday speech, ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ is more natural. {高値|たかね} specifically refers to a price level, especially in market and trading contexts.
